accounts.name: token_program
docs: USDC is a classic token, and Raydium takes the classic program in this slot whatever the pool trades

accounts.name: payout
docs: USDC to be paid in cash, or senior shares to be paid in those

accounts.name: base_asset
docs: The LP's priced token, whose own pause and activation delay apply to its LPs too

accounts.name: junior_escrow
docs: Holds junior shares while they wait in the exit queue

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: The senior or junior share mint, checked against the pool in the handler

accounts.name: share_mint
docs: The senior or junior share mint, checked against the pool in the handler

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Moves the USDC, which is always a classic token

accounts.name: collateral_token_program
docs: Moves the collateral, classic or Token-2022 as the asset was listed

accounts.name: senior_escrow
docs: Holds senior shares while they wait in the withdrawal queue, made by the first exit

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone, usually the keeper, who also pays for the owner's USDC account if it is missing

accounts.name: exit
docs: Only the exit at the head of the queue can be settled

accounts.name: owner_usdc
docs: The owner's associated USDC account, made here if it is missing, so no owner can stall the queue by closing it

types.name: Asset
docs: A whitelisted collateral token

fields.name: active_at
docs: Backs new debt only from here, so juniors can leave before a new listing adds risk

fields.name: pending
docs: Looser parameters waiting out the activation delay, live from `pending_at`, which is 0 when nothing waits

fields.name: var_fast
docs: Fast and slow averages of the price's variance per second, scaled by VOL_SCALE

fields.name: vol_price
docs: The price and publish time of the last volatility sample

fields.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token or Token-2022, which every transfer of this asset must go through

fields.name: mult
docs: For a Token-2022 token with a corporate-action multiplier: the one in effect when last synced and the one before,
in tokens per share scaled by 1e9

fields.name: mult_since
docs: When `mult` took effect: exactly for a change scheduled ahead, otherwise when it was first seen; 0 before any change

fields.name: mult_prev_since
docs: When `mult_prev` took effect, so a price older than that is known to be on neither basis

fields.name: jump_since
docs: Publish time of the first sample that jumped far from the last one with no multiplier change, 0 when none

fields.name: jump_price
docs: The latest far token price of that jump and its publish time

fields.name: reserved
docs: Room for fields added later without moving the ones above

fields.name: group
docs: Column in the shock tables, where anything >= MAX_GROUPS is never shocked

fields.name: vol_horizon_secs
docs: Liquidation horizon T for the dynamic shock, about a day for crypto and three for stocks so a weekend fits, 0 for none

fields.name: rate_source
docs: For a liquid staking token: where its SOL backing is read, and the price is the lower of its own and that SOL's worth

fields.name: rate_account
docs: The stake pool account for RATE_STAKE_POOL

fields.name: fixed_rate
docs: SOL per whole token, scaled by 1e9, for RATE_FIXED

fields.name: rate_base_mint
docs: The SOL price to value the backing with: the SOL mint for demo prices, its Pyth feed otherwise

fields.name: liq_price_age_secs
docs: Oldest price that still counts for liquidations and the liquidation line, at least `max_price_age_secs`
Longer for stocks so a weekend's last price still lets bad debt be liquidated, while draws keep the short limit

fields.name: ui_multiplier
docs: Multiply the per-share price by the mint's corporate-action multiplier, for a per-share feed on a scaled token

fields.name: jump_hold_secs
docs: How long a multiplier token's price jump must hold, with no multiplier change, before it counts as a real move:
longer than the issuer could lag the feed in applying a split

fields.name: covered_by_buffer
docs: Lenders' interest not yet paid out, which takes losses first

types.name: ChangeQueued
docs: A change to the pool, an asset or an LP market, named by `target`, waits until `effective_at`

types.name: DemoPrice
docs: Admin-written price that replaces Pyth while `Pool::demo_mode` is on

types.name: EpochOpened
docs: A payout epoch opened: `budget` is paid out of `buffer` evenly until `end`, split between the tranches by their weights

fields.name: position_unclear
docs: Positions whose price is unclear around a corporate action, which can't be seized yet

types.name: JuniorExit
docs: A junior lender's shares in the exit queue, held in the pool's escrow until claimed or cancelled
They stay junior money until then: they keep earning and keep taking losses

fields.name: value
docs: What the shares were worth when queued, the most the exit can pay

fields.name: window_secs
docs: Terms fixed when the exit was queued, so later parameter changes can only improve them

types.name: JuniorExitCancelled
docs: `returned` of the queued `shares` went back to the owner, the rest were burned with the yield earned while queued

types.name: JuniorExitClaimed
docs: `paid` is USDC, or its worth in senior shares when `in_usdc` is false, after the `fee` left with junior lenders

fields.name: value
docs: The most the exit can pay, before its fee

types.name: JuniorExitsPaused
docs: Junior exits are frozen until `until`, which is the present when a pause is lifted

types.name: LpMarket
docs: A whitelisted Orca Whirlpool or Raydium CLMM pool whose positions count as collateral, always quoted in USDC

fields.name: whirlpool
docs: The pool, Orca or Raydium

fields.name: active_at
docs: Backs new debt only from here, so juniors can leave before a new listing adds risk

fields.name: pending_liq_cost_bps
docs: A lower liquidation cost or an unpause waiting out the activation delay, live from `pending_at` when that is not 0

fields.name: dex_program
docs: The program that owns the pool and its positions

fields.name: base_first
docs: Whether the base token is the pool's first token and USDC its second, which turns the range around when it is not

types.name: Pool
docs: The single USDC lending pool plus protocol config

fields.name: junior_mint
docs: Share mint of the junior tranche, unset until the admin opens it

fields.name: guardian
docs: May only tighten risk: pause collateral and drop waiting changes, never pause junior exits

fields.name: demo_mode
docs: When set, prices come from admin-written demo accounts instead of Pyth

fields.name: cash
docs: USDC held for lenders and reserves, tracked here so stray transfers cannot move the share price

fields.name: reserves
docs: Insurance fund: a claim on pool assets that absorbs bad debt before lenders

fields.name: protocol_fees
docs: Protocol revenue the admin can collect, also a claim on pool assets

fields.name: min_liq_cost_bps
docs: Lowest liquidation cost any priced asset or LP market has been given, which caps the liquidation bonus

fields.name: usdc_group
docs: Shock group of the USDC asset, applied to the USDC side of LP positions as well

fields.name: junior_assets
docs: Part of the lender assets that belongs to junior lenders, who absorb losses before senior ones

fields.name: dust
docs: Fractions of a base unit still owed to reserves, protocol fees and junior lenders

fields.name: borrow_index
docs: One borrow index per loyalty tier, since a shared index cannot charge different rates

fields.name: junior_queued
docs: Junior shares waiting in the exit queue

fields.name: junior_pause_start
docs: The latest governance pause of junior exits, from start until end

fields.name: junior_next_pause_at
docs: Earliest start of the next pause, fixed when a pause starts or is lifted so a later cut to the gap cannot bring it forward

fields.name: pending_params
docs: Looser parameters waiting out the activation delay, live from `pending_at`, which is 0 when nothing waits

fields.name: yield_buffer
docs: Lenders' interest not yet paid out: it collects here and is paid out evenly over the next epoch
It belongs to no lender until paid, so it takes losses first

fields.name: epoch_start
docs: The current payout epoch and the budget it pays out evenly, fixed when it opened

fields.name: senior_queued
docs: Senior shares waiting in the withdrawal queue, held in the senior escrow
Added after launch: `migrate_pool` grows a pool created before them, and the new bytes start at zero

fields.name: senior_reserved
docs: The most the queued senior exits can be owed, held back from idle cash so nothing else spends it first

fields.name: senior_next_ticket
docs: Ticket the next queued senior exit gets, and the ticket the queue pays next

types.name: PoolParams
docs: Admin-set risk and rate parameters
Shocks are a scenario-by-group table in bps: row = scenario, column = risk group

fields.name: init_shock_bps
docs: Applied when debt grows or collateral leaves

fields.name: maint_shock_bps
docs: Applied when deciding whether an account can be liquidated

fields.name: warn_health_bps
docs: Health under this drops the account to the base rate tier

fields.name: reserve_factor_bps
docs: Share of borrower interest kept as the insurance reserve

fields.name: protocol_fee_bps
docs: Share of borrower interest the protocol keeps as revenue

fields.name: yield_margin_bps
docs: Share of the yield buffer held back when an epoch opens, so it carries into the next one
It smooths the yield from week to week and takes losses before anyone else

fields.name: epoch_secs
docs: Length of a payout epoch, aligned to Fridays at 00:00 UTC, or 0 to pay lenders' interest out as it accrues

fields.name: junior_target_bps
docs: Junior share of lender assets at which junior lenders earn the whole premium, below it the premium scales down

fields.name: junior_premium_bps
docs: Risk premium: junior lenders earn the senior rate plus this share of the senior yield on every senior dollar they cover
Junior rate = senior rate x (1 + premium x senior / junior), the premium scaled down below the target share

fields.name: junior_min_delay_secs
docs: Wait before a queued junior exit can be claimed, from the min with an empty queue up to the max

fields.name: junior_delay_threshold_bps
docs: Queued share of the junior supply at which the wait reaches its max

fields.name: junior_exit_window_secs
docs: Time after the wait in which an exit must be claimed, or it lapses and the shares go back to work
Between MIN_JUNIOR_EXIT_WINDOW_SECS and MAX_JUNIOR_EXIT_WINDOW_SECS

fields.name: junior_exit_fee_bps
docs: Taken from a junior claim and left with the junior lenders who stay

fields.name: junior_max_pause_secs
docs: Longest governance pause of junior exits, never above MAX_JUNIOR_PAUSE_SECS

fields.name: junior_pause_gap_secs
docs: Unpaused time required between two pauses: at least the longest wait plus MAX_JUNIOR_EXIT_WINDOW_SECS,
and at least the activation delay

fields.name: activation_delay_secs
docs: Wait before new collateral, or any change that is not a pure tightening, takes effect
At least the longest junior wait plus the claim window, so juniors who disagree can leave first

fields.name: z_init_x100
docs: Dynamic shock d = z x sigma x sqrt(T) per asset, with z in hundredths for the draw and liquidation tables

fields.name: vol_tau_fast_secs
docs: Two averages of each asset's variance: the fast one lets a rise in volatility in quickly, the slow one makes it fade slowly

fields.name: vol_min_interval_secs
docs: A volatility sample needs a price this much newer than the last one, at most this old and this certain

fields.name: max_shock_bps
docs: Largest shock any scenario can apply, dynamic or not

fields.name: mint
docs: Token mint, or the position NFT mint of an LP

fields.name: amount
docs: Token base units, or 1 for an LP position

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump of the dex's address for an LP position, so the health check can confirm it cheaply

fields.name: source
docs: Where the USDC came from: 0 wallet, 1 autopay from LP fees, 2 the account's own USDC collateral

types.name: SeniorExit
docs: A senior lender's shares in the withdrawal queue, one account per ticket, held in the senior escrow until settled
Queued shares earn nothing but still take losses, and the queue pays tickets strictly in order

fields.name: value
docs: What the shares were worth when queued, the most the exit can pay

fields.name: cancelled
docs: Cancelled exits keep their ticket until the queue reaches it, so the head can always move on

types.name: SeniorExitCancelled
docs: `returned` of the queued `shares` went back to the owner, the rest were burned with the yield earned while queued

types.name: SeniorExitRequested
docs: Senior shares queued for withdrawal: `value` is the most they can pay, and `ticket` their place in the queue

types.name: SeniorExitSettled
docs: The queue reached `ticket`: `paid` USDC went to the owner, or nothing when the exit had been cancelled

types.name: TrancheConverted
docs: Senior shares turned into junior shares, `value` USDC moving between the tranches

types.name: VolUpdated
docs: A price sample folded into `mint`'s volatility, with the dynamic shocks it now gives in bps
